title: Logic Decision
text: Threshold crossing detector at input to binary process, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Sample time} sets the source of sample, {Sample time value} sets the actual value of sample, {Minimum delay value} sets the minimum propagation delay and {Buffer size} sets the number of threshold crossings to buffer. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: wave
ports.summary: Input signal fixed step sampling | variable step sampling | scalar

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Source of sample time Inherited (default) | Fixed

params.name: Sample time value
params.values: Actual value of sample time 20e-12 (default) | real scalar excluding zero

params.name: Minimum delay value
params.values: Minimum propagation delay value 1e-15 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Buffer size
params.values: Number of threshold crossings to buffer 1 (default) | positive integer scalar
